answer: Here is one concrete wall: Recognised barrister chambers warrant with bar council endorsement. It works because a warrant the council confirms after annual review, and the dawn it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the thread is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Time is the tax here: a warrant the council confirms after annual review cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the lotus for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
